step: Size consistency audit, step 1: one frame per glass on the product page, and no plate-era size limits on component-library drawings
data: production (precise-raccoon-123), read-only; desktop 1440 x 900, product stage 672 x 540
method: The audit's pdp-stage.ts (PR #300) run twice on the same production data: before = main's framing, after = this branch. Before-mode reproduced the original audit exactly (0 of 2,479 SKUs differed). Glass width measured from the drawn images; a SKU is off when its glass is more than 3% from its group's reference.

perPage.note: What a customer sees in one page's cap and colour swapper: glass width against the page's own component-library variants.
perPage.remaining: Every page still changing size mixes library drawings with store photos or legacy per-SKU kits (steps 3 and 4).

libraryFrames.note: Component-library (register) SKUs grouped by glass and frame key: the glass, or one of its hanging tops (vintage bulb sprayer, with or without tassel).
libraryFrames.remaining: All 38 are Elegant 60 mL: its frosted photo body is drawn 5% narrower than the clear plate at the same height (an image fix).

perGlassStrict.note: The audit's original grouping (one reference per glass). The 189 frame differences left are the bulb-sprayer pages, framed on their own by design.

sizeChanges.note: Library SKUs whose drawn glass width changed by more than 3%.

largestShrink.Elegant 60 mL plain bulb-sprayer pages: -17%: five tassel sprayers on the clear plain page are labelled plain in the catalogue, so the page is framed for a tassel
largestShrink.reducer and dropper pages: -5% to -10% (Cylinder 25, Slim 30, Diamond 60, Round 78): framed with the same glass's lotion-pump overcap

capacityLadder.note: Glass height on screen for library drawings, standard tops.
capacityLadder.caveat: Every glass taller than 76 mm is drawn 800 px tall by the register datum, so tall capacities differ less than they physically do (unchanged by this step).
